name: cinematic-video-prompt-h3
description: Cinematic video prompt vocabulary pack adapted for MiniMax H3 video generation. Three Agent Skills: the main prompt-writing skill (H3 field schema + 700+ cinematography terms translated into H3's natural-language shot-description grammar across 10 reference files), a character-sheet-lite skill for I2VA/Ref2VA character consistency, and an oriental-scene-lite skill for Wuxia and Eastern-aesthetic scenes. Pure-skills plugin; no MCP servers.
